summary.final_conclusion: No explored strategy supports a prospective alpha or capital-deployment claim. The parent same-day screen falsified the BTC/ETH post-liquidation continuation overlay at its registered 20-onset stop; an exact-rule chronological replication was inconclusive at 6/20 and cannot reverse that falsification. The parent Deribit taker-GEX screen and its exact-rule replication were both sample-first inconclusive at 10/12 transitions; the replication also missed its 1,000-trade minimum at 732 and all four descriptive gates were false. Public collectors remain active for separately frozen future mechanisms, not retrospective rescue.

positive_evidence: Signed funding remains an economically real premium.
An arithmetic-only repair of the inadmissible frozen position gives 2024 signed funding of 12.38%-13.87% of actual short notional; this is a counterfactual diagnostic, not corrected-engine economics.
negative_evidence: Frozen engine clipped every negative rate, used the wrong yield denominator, mis-accrued SOFR, and reserved no independent perpetual collateral.
The corrected gross<=1x independently collateralized entry-and-hold engine terminated both sleeves in December 2020, so its 2024 funding yield and strategy return are 0.0%.
The 2025 and 2026 signed-funding decay figures are counterfactual rate diagnostics for a hypothetical surviving short, not corrected-engine portfolio economics.

review_findings.finding: Frozen carry parser max(rate,0) clips every negative funding rate.
Frozen carry reported funding yield against sleeve equity/2 rather than actual short notional.
Frozen carry invests the full sleeve in spot while reserving no separate USD-M margin; gross exposure starts near 2x and grows with price.
Frozen carry SOFR benchmark drops weekends/holidays and uses ACT/365 instead of carried-forward ACT/360.

Corrected-audit production code returns a daily SOFR rate/360 but applies it at every hourly observation, over-accruing the cash benchmark by approximately 24x. Its report/returns benchmark and excess metrics are invalid; this does not change the observed December-2020 collateral terminations or zero 2024 position/funding.
Factor pass gate tests a validation effect statistically indistinguishable from zero and uses a non-investable factor return.
